fields.title: 7. Proposed New Rules — None
fields.md:
Existing proposals ①–⑤ are retained. No rule is conditioned on congressional authorization or appropriations action. Whether to propose one will be decided by the monthly run after it sees an actual budget line move in the IAA and NDAA reviews (2027). Creating a rule at the warning stage would attach numbers to a statement (source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied`).
